label: Kimi K3.1 Pro
output:
**TO WHOEVER HAS BEEN DUMPING RUBBISH IN MY BIN**

I’m the tenant at No. 14, Aughrim Terrace. My bin is the grey Greenmount Bins one with **14 painted in white on the lid**. It goes out on Tuesday night and is collected on Wednesday morning.

For roughly the last month, somebody has been filling it with bags of rubbish that aren’t mine. This isn’t the odd bottle or a few bits tucked in on top. It’s full black bags, nearly every week.

Last Tuesday, I got home at 3am after a gig and found the lid wouldn’t even close because there were three more black bags in it. One contained nappies. I also found a gas bill envelope in one of the bags, with the name torn off and only the terrace left visible. A neighbour across the road saw a car pull up on Tuesday evening too, though they didn’t see who it was.

Just so we’re clear about what this costs: my bin is charged by weight at **41 cent per kilo**. My last bill was **€63.20 for two months**, when it’s normally around **€25**. I’m paying for somebody else to avoid dealing with their own rubbish, and I’ve had enough of it.

I’m not paying for your crap anymore.

If you’re genuinely stuck and don’t know how to arrange a collection or get rid of something properly, ask me. Call to No. 14 and I’ll tell you who to ring. It’s not hard, and it’s a better option than sneaking your bags into somebody else’s bin.

I work nights, so I’m often coming and going at hours you might not expect. I’m also not a pushover. I don’t want a row with anyone I have to live beside, but I’m not going to keep quietly absorbing the cost and pretending this is fine.

If it continues, I’ll start locking the bin with a padlock. I’d rather not have to do that, but I will.

To everyone else on the terrace, apologies for putting this through your letterbox. I’m not accusing every house here, because I don’t know who’s responsible. But whoever you are, you know exactly what you’ve been doing.

**Stop. Simple as.**

**Resident, No. 14**
